answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes: newcomers earn trust only after trading with 12 unrelated counterparties over 20 epochs, like an orchard fruiting when trees cross-pollinate. Earnings sit in a vault, released as counterparties confirm delivery; a willow-like rule bends once for slow ones. Forging 100 clones needs 1,200 counterparties and 4,000 credits of deposits, more than clones earn; honest agents pay 40 once and keep every credit.
